wholePhysicalScope: The named OSM multipolygon gives the outer cloister, open court, 12-point main temple and adjacent northern shrine, corroborated by OSM node Q3437182 and the official monument descriptions.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the Chola sanctuary tower, pillared halls, chariot porch and encircling cloister. Nearer levels add sculptural niches, modeled stone trim, and wheels.
limitations: Tier and hall proportions are based on the measured compound and dated source views. Stone carving, individual deities, inscriptions, columns away from the pictured run and the horse ornaments are modeled as simplified relief.
The interior shrine, later ramps and utilities, detached east gopuram and neighboring Devanayaki Temple are beyond the selected compound.
